headline: Zhipu AI's flash model holds top spot despite daily slip
summary: Zhipu AI's glm-5.3-flash leads at 11.6% token share, down 2.3 points from yesterday, while OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna climbs to rank 2 with a 7-spot weekly surge. MiniMax's free tier makes a dramatic 25-rank jump over the week, now sitting at rank 6 with 5.0% share.
highlights: Zhipu AI (glm-5.3-flash-20260826) holds rank 1 at 11.6% token share, but lost 2.3 percentage points in one day
OpenAI (gpt-5.6-luna-20260709) climbs to rank 2 with 10.9% share, up 7 ranks over 7 days and 1.8 percentage points today
MiniMax (minimax-m3-20260531:free) surges 25 ranks in a week to rank 6, now at 5.0% share
Tencent (hy4-preview-20260827) enters top 3 at rank 3 with 10.6% share, up 4.0 percentage points today
Qwen (qwen3.8-27b-20260814) debuts at rank 48 with 0.2% share
NVIDIA (nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b-20230311:free) drops out after holding rank 47
